messages:
Leila P: Ok team — Montreal (mtl) GCP region onboarding with NimbusCloud and LambdaCompute (HW partner). Need quota for A100-80GB x12 & marketplace entitlement. Target go-live: 2026-05-12. Who owns GCP quota request + marketplace listing fields? cc @Ajay @Maria
Ajay K: I can own the quota request. Need exact SKU names, regions, and the project IDs to submit. Also please confirm expected sustained vs burst capacity.
Sam R: VPC peering required. We'll need proposed IP ranges and firewall rules. Also: how will private networking to LambdaCompute be done — direct attach or overVPN? Any on-prem colocation to consider?
Maria P: I'll drive the marketplace listing. Need logos (SVG + PNG), short + long descriptions, pricing mapping to our SKU names, and support contacts. Do we have a partner portal invite from Nimbus yet?
nimbus-bot: Nimbus: Partner portal invite sent to leila@redwood.com. Uploaded an initial entitlement pack — link: https://partners.nimbus/example-token (partner-only).
Zane T: Sales question: what SLA tier do we plan to sell at launch and will Dedicated starter pools be available day 1? Need to align go-to-market collateral.
Ben L: Legal: we need joint announcement review (logos, copy) and the co-marketing terms. Please add partner SOC2 summary and their MSA draft to Confluence. Also confirm export control checks for A100 shipments to Canada — I'll loop in Compliance.
Leila P: Action items to confirm: 1) Ajay: open GCP quota ticket with SKUs + proj IDs. 2) Maria: marketplace asset bundle. 3) Ben: start announcement & co-marketing review. 4) Sam: network + IAM details. Target internal freeze for launch artifacts: 2026-04-28. I'll coordinate weekly syncs.
Ajay K: Opened quota ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-mtl — ticket #123456789. Requested SKUs: `nvidia-a100-80gb` (12 units) in `northamerica-northeast1` (mtl). GCP rep ETA ~5 business days. Assigned to Ajay K.
Sam R: Sharing temporary IP range for peering: `10.180.0.0/20`. Will add full ranges + NSG rules to Confluence. We'll need IAM service account: `redwood-marketplace-provisioner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
Maria P: Marketplace checklist here: https://drive.google.com/mtl-marketplace-checklist. I'll upload logos, short/long descriptions, and pricing mapping by EOD Friday. Also need partner point-of-contact for support routing.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace: entitlement form received from Nimbus. Status: pending partner verification.
Ben L: Please upload partner SOC2 and MSA to the Confluence page. We'll redact sensitive pricing before any public joint announcement. Also need a copy of their trademark usage policy for the press release.
Zane T: If quotas are green we can plan a partner webinar the week after go-live. Hold on external copy until Legal signs off.
Eli F: Eli F: finance will need a cost estimate for 12 A100s + network + marketplace fees. Send SKU counts x region multiplier and I'll route for budget approval.
Leila P: I'll compile the cost estimate into the shared doc today. Weekly syncs Tuesdays 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent. Thanks all :thumbsup:
